title: BlockDeletedV1
description: A block has been deleted from the tree of a page. Every deleted block gets a Block Deleted of its own, the blocks nested in it included, so the threads anchored to each of them can be deleted.

pageId.description: The PageId of the page whose tree held the block.

blockId.description: The BlockId of the deleted block, unique in its page: the replica that inserted it and the Lamport counter of that insertion, as in the protocol of the CRDT package.

pageBlocks.description: The page blocks deleted with this block, the block itself when it is a page block and every page block nested in it, each with its sub-page, so that every sub-page underneath is deleted too; empty when there is none.

blockId.description: The BlockId of the page block.

subPage.description: The PageId of the sub-page the page block holds.
